title: Why ChatGPT Types Like It's Thinking

segments.text: You ask ChatGPT a question. It starts typing. Slowly.
It's not. The answer is already computed.
But it can't give it all at once. Each word depends on the previous word.
To generate word one hundred, it must process words one through ninety nine. In order.
Behind the scenes is the KV cache. It remembers what every previous word was paying attention to.
The longer the conversation, the bigger this cache. At one hundred thousand words, it's eating fifty gigabytes.
Your GPU multiplies a billion numbers instantly. But generates tokens one at a time.
This is why a five hundred word answer takes thirty seconds. Not thinking. Physics.
The typing animation is the actual speed of generation. Fifty tokens per second. Physics.
